## What's new since v6.1.6-pre.2

### Fixed

- **The DNS log no longer crashes on Android 13 and older.** Opening it closed the app on any version before Android 14.

### Under the hood

- Builds now refuse code that needs a newer Android than the app supports, so this kind of crash can't ship again.
- The tests for GitHub, Gist and GitLab hosted sources no longer depend on those sites answering, which had started failing every build.

Everything in [v6.1.6-pre.2](https://github.com/bushman74/AdAway-but-Monet/releases/tag/v6.1.6-pre.2) is included.
